questions.subject: stanley_park
questions.q_en: Stanley Park is in which city?
questions.q_zh: 斯坦利公园在哪个城市？
questions.explain_en: It is right next to downtown Vancouver.
questions.explain_zh: 它就在温哥华市中心旁边。

questions.subject: stanley_park
questions.q_en: Which bridge goes from Stanley Park to the North Shore?
questions.q_zh: 哪座桥从斯坦利公园通往北岸？
questions.explain_en: Lions Gate Bridge opened in 1938. It links Stanley Park to the North Shore.
questions.explain_zh: 狮门大桥 1938 年通车，连接斯坦利公园和北岸。

questions.subject: stanley_park
questions.q_en: The Nine O'Clock Gun fires every night at…
questions.q_zh: Nine O'Clock Gun 每天晚上几点开炮？
questions.explain_en: It's been a Vancouver tradition for over 100 years.
questions.explain_zh: 这是温哥华一百多年的传统。

questions.subject: nature
questions.q_en: Raccoons are nocturnal. That means they are active…
questions.q_zh: 浣熊是夜行动物，意思是它们什么时候活动？
questions.explain_en: Nocturnal animals sleep in the day.

questions.subject: nature
questions.q_en: Bats are…
questions.q_zh: 蝙蝠属于哪一类动物？
questions.explain_en: Bats have fur and feed milk to babies.

questions.subject: nature
questions.q_en: Which tall bird with long legs nests in Stanley Park?
questions.q_zh: 哪种长腿高个子的鸟在斯坦利公园筑巢？
questions.explain_en: Herons build big nests high in the trees.
questions.explain_zh: 大蓝鹭在高高的树上搭大窝。

questions.subject: nature
questions.q_en: B.C.'s official tree, found all over Stanley Park, is the…
questions.q_zh: 卑诗省的省树，斯坦利公园到处都有，是什么树？
questions.explain_en: The western red cedar is B.C.'s tree.
questions.explain_zh: 西部红雪松是卑诗省的省树。

questions.subject: halloween
questions.q_en: A pumpkin is mostly made of…
questions.q_zh: 南瓜里面大部分是什么？

questions.subject: halloween
questions.q_en: Long ago in Ireland, the first jack-o'-lanterns were carved from…
questions.q_zh: 很久以前在爱尔兰，最早的南瓜灯是用什么雕的？
questions.explain_en: People switched to pumpkins in North America.
questions.explain_zh: 到了北美，人们才改用南瓜。

questions.subject: nature
questions.q_en: Which star do we see that lights up the Moon?
questions.q_zh: 月亮的光其实来自哪颗星？

questions.subject: safety
questions.q_en: On the Stanley Park seawall, bikes must ride…
questions.q_zh: 在斯坦利公园海堤上，自行车必须朝哪个方向骑？
questions.explain_en: Bikes go one way around the park, counter-clockwise, in their own lane.
questions.explain_zh: 自行车在自己的车道上，绕公园逆时针单向骑行。

questions.subject: stanley_park
questions.q_en: Stanley Park is famous for its path along the water called the…
questions.q_zh: 斯坦利公园沿水边的那条著名小路叫什么？
questions.explain_en: People walk, run and bike on the seawall.
questions.explain_zh: 人们在海堤上散步、跑步、骑车。

questions.subject: halloween
questions.q_en: How many legs does a spider have?
questions.q_zh: 蜘蛛有几条腿？
questions.explain_zh: 蜘蛛有 8 条腿，昆虫有 6 条。

questions.subject: halloween
questions.q_en: What do we carve for Halloween?
questions.q_zh: 万圣节我们会雕刻什么？

questions.subject: nature
questions.q_en: Which animal has a black mask on its face?
questions.q_zh: 哪种动物脸上像戴着黑色面罩？
questions.explain_en: Raccoons live in Stanley Park and come out at night.
questions.explain_zh: 斯坦利公园里有浣熊，晚上出来活动。

questions.subject: nature
questions.q_en: Which animal says 'hoo-hoo' at night?
questions.q_zh: 晚上“呼呼”叫的是什么动物？

questions.subject: capybara
questions.q_en: CAPYBARA! Bara loves water. Would Bara like the seawall?
questions.q_zh: CAPYBARA！Bara 爱水，它会喜欢海堤吗？
questions.explain_en: Capybaras love water, though they prefer fresh water.
questions.explain_zh: 卡皮巴拉爱水，不过它们更喜欢淡水。

questions.subject: capybara
questions.q_en: CAPYBARA! What costume suits a capybara best?
questions.q_zh: CAPYBARA！哪套万圣节服装最适合卡皮巴拉？
questions.explain_en: Bara can't skate, but a pumpkin hat looks great!
questions.explain_zh: Bara 不会溜冰，但戴南瓜帽超好看！

questions.subject: capybara
questions.q_en: CAPYBARA! Capybaras and raccoons both come from…
questions.q_zh: CAPYBARA！卡皮巴拉和浣熊老家都在哪个大洲？
questions.explain_en: Capybaras are from South America; raccoons from North America.
questions.explain_zh: 卡皮巴拉来自南美洲，浣熊来自北美洲。
